dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge with a deep concave spline fitting from the mid-point of the posterior margin to the dorsal ridge junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, indicating a relatively pointed tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with an initial 40-45 degree slope relative to the horizontal body axis, increasing in steepness as it approaches the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.6:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch visible on the trailing edge near the posterior insertion point; cluster of light-colored, irregular markings on the dorsal ridge posterior to the fin.
